items.title: Portland Fire came back to beat Golden State in OT, so the Minnesota Lynx — despite a bad loss tonight in Indy — have secured the No. 1 seed in the 2026 WNBA playoffs.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Portland Fire came back to beat Golden State in OT, so the Minnesota Lynx — despite a bad loss tonight in Indy — have secured the No. 1 seed in the 2026 WNBA playoffs.

And now it'll be interesting to see how they handle Thursday's home game against the Fever.

items.title: Quite the night for the Minnesota Lynx, who lost to the Fever and saw their starters get benched in the second half but still clinch the No. 1 seed in the playoffs with the Portland Fire’s overtime win over the Golden State Valkyries.

items.body_excerpt:
